humanRequest: Can we enable remote Powershell so you can run commands directly? That would make things alot easier in this lab.
question: Approve a one-off Azure Run Command setup for OpenSSH Server, a dedicated local SSH key and key-only PowerShell command access through private Bastion? This extends the read-only approval. It will install the Windows SSH component if needed, configure sshd and a Bastion-subnet-only guest firewall rule. No public IP, shared-network change, password login, WinRM listener or reboot.
keyStorage: Dedicated unencrypted Ed25519 key in owner-only 0700 local state directory, private file 0600, outside Git. Private key never copied to guest, logs or command arguments.
hostKeyTrust: Pin only the host PUBLIC key returned by owner-authorised Azure Run Command on the exact VM, then StrictHostKeyChecking=yes with a dedicated known_hosts file. No TOFU, ssh-keyscan or host-key bypass.
